summary: Combines selectattr and rejectattr over dictsort(hostvars) to use ansible_host when defined and fall back to the inventory name otherwise, for checking SSH reachability.
questions: How do I get each host's ansible_host or fall back to its inventory name?
How do I check which inventory hosts respond on port 22?

answer_card.title: Using ansible_host with a fallback to inventory name
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- wait_for:
    host: "{{ item }}"
    port: 22
  loop: '{{ has_ah + no_ah }}'
  vars:
    has_ah: '{{ hostvars|dictsort|selectattr("1.ansible_host", "defined")|map(attribute="1.ansible_host")|list }}'
    no_ah: '{{ hostvars|dictsort|rejectattr("1.ansible_host", "defined")|map(attribute="0")|list }}'
```
